- ACARS: the decoder now reads the bits the way aircraft send them (a 2400 Hz tone repeats the previous bit, 1200 Hz inverts it), as acarsdec does. Real messages can now be decoded
- Listen: zoom from 2 MHz down to 125 kHz with buttons or a two-finger pinch, the view following the channel
- Listen: a tuning step to choose (100 Hz to 100 kHz, or the mode's own), and the frequency shown to 100 Hz
- Listen: many more stations, sorted in tabs (radio amateur, broadcast, air & sea, utility, space): shortwave broadcast bands, medium wave, HF amateur bands, FT8, VOLMET, CB, WWV, ISS… Stations the radio cannot tune are hidden
- Spectrum: zoom ×1 to ×16 around the centre, waterfall included, with buttons or a pinch
- Tools: category tabs for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and SDR tools (aviation, sea & rescue, mesh & LoRa, satellites & weather, home & sensors, voice & pagers…), with an "All" tab and the number of tools in each
